text: In response to safety concerns raised by residents on Vessel Crescent, including a petition submitted to my office, I request that Transportation Services staff conduct a study of traffic calming measures on Vessel Crescent to determine the feasibility of installing speed humps, reducing the speed limit to 30km/h, and with consideration of any other appropriate measures.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Requested the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services, to investigate the feasibility of traffic calming measures on Vessel Crescent with respect to revised warrant criteria for traffic calming, and report back to the May 6, 2024 meeting Scarborough Community Council.
